extras: The free plan includes 50 MB and one cloud vault; paid plans are required for more capacity. Encryption and history do not replace independent backups.
intentEvidence: End-to-end encrypted sync for Obsidian — with LAN acceleration when your devices are on the same network.
problem: Users need a secure, private way to synchronize their vault data across multiple devices without compromising data privacy or relying solely on cloud providers.
summary: End-to-end encrypted synchronization for Obsidian notes, attachments, and settings, featuring LAN acceleration and client-side encryption.
